headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with AI driving gains for some firms while others faced modest expansion and guidance cuts.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from a low 1.5% at Infosys to a high 53.6% at Coforge. AI-related revenue surged at several companies, notably Infosys (+29% YoY) and HCLTech ($219 m). Margin guidance was tightened at Infosys and raised at Coforge. Profit trends were mixed, with HCLTech posting a 21% jump and Wipro seeing a 1.9% decline.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue acceleration
themes.detail: AI contributed strong top‑line growth at Infosys, HCLTech, LTM and Mphasis, with AI revenue up 29% YoY at Infosys and $219 m at HCLTech.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue growth guidance to 1‑2%, reflecting modest outlook despite AI momentum.

themes.title: Margin improvements
themes.detail: Coforge raised its FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16% and HCLTech maintained an operating margin above 18%.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Revenue up 11.5% YoY, profit jumped 21%, and AI revenue reached $219 m.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% and headcount declined.
